profile.headline: Full-Stack Developer | Artist | Sound-maker
profile.summary: I am a full-stack software developer with a passion for front end development. I attended Epicodus after spending time in the music tech industry using my creative problem solving skills as an Operations Manager, where I gained a spark of fascination and inspiration to dive into programming. During my time learning to code, I became devoted to becoming a JavaScript/C#/React wizard! Post Epicodus I spent time interning on the development team at iVET360, where I used the skills I learned at Epicodus and my creative skills gained through Portland State University’s competitive BFA Art Practices program to create eye-catching UI components and engaging user experiences.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Skills: Communication · JavaScript · Figma (Software) · Front-end Design · Web Design · Web Development · HTML5 · Wordpress Development · User Interface Design

positions.title: Operations Manager
positions.description:
Running day to day operations of the company:
- Handled supplier relations and parts purchasing
- Receiving and inspection of all parts
- Communicated with vendors and was responsible for order management
- Managed all facets of production including: scheduling, inventory, labor, inspection
- Performed production work
- Responsible for shipping customer and vendor orders including export orders
- Provided Customer Support via email in regards to product issues and inquiries
- Created system for tracking inventory

positions.title: Operations Assistant
positions.description:
- Designed custom products to meet client needs
- Provided project mock-ups to clients using Adobe Illustrator
- Created and provided estimates for client projects
- Handled Invoicing for client projects
- Operated CO2 Laser, cutting and engraving a wide variety of materials
- Used woodworking skills and knowledge to build and finish projects
- Operated basic woodworking machinery
- Created an online store for the company
positions.insights: Skills: Communication · Web Design · HTML5 · Adobe Photoshop · Wordpress Development

positions.title: Fabrication Assistant
positions.description:
- Operated CO2 Laser, cutting and engraving a wide variety of materials
- Used woodworking and fabrication skills to build and finish projects
- Operated basic woodworking machinery
- Boxing and shipping of finished projects
- Helped fulfill projects for companies such as Nike, Counter Culture Coffee, and Portland based Design firms

projects.title: My Calculator
projects.description:
This is a cute little calculator program that I made. It has the functionality of a basic calculator, allowing the user to add, subtract, multiply, or divide!

Technologies Used: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery

projects.title: Nine Livers Tap Room
projects.description: This is a React application that keeps track of kegs that are added to a tap room. The app allows the user to add new kegs, view keg details, delete kegs, and track how much left is in a keg in remaining pints.
